title: PLAME: Lightweight MSA Design Advances Protein Folding From Evolutionary Embeddings
description:
PLAME generates virtual multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) from the evolutionary embeddings of a pretrained protein language model (ESM-2), enabling AlphaFold-family pipelines to fold low-homology and orphan proteins without a homology database search. The encoder applies tied row and column axial attention over the 2D MSA; the decoder generates sequences autoregressively. A conservation-diversity objective (PSSM-weighted cross-entropy plus an entropy regularizer) balances faithful reproduction of conserved positions against plausible sequence variation. HiFiAD, a model-agnostic BLOSUM-based criterion, selects candidate sequences without repeated AlphaFold evaluations.

This record archives the source code accompanying the associated manuscript. Trained model weights and all generated MSAs are archived separately at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21429061.
